children: Changes to FTSE All-Share Ex-Multinational Constituents

FTSE Russell announces that, pursuant to the review of the FTSE UK All-Share Index, the following changes will be made to the FTSE All-Share Ex-Multinational Index. The changes will be effective after the close of business on Friday, 18 September 2026 (i.e. effective on Monday, 21 September 2026).
